//: Hardens the reset/POR/user-ID support sub-block (dw_reset_support) into a
//2: LEF/GDS/nl macro with clean boundary pins. The four caravel-hardened
//3: support cells are placed here and their interconnect (incl. simple_por's
//4: buried por_l/porb_l nubs) is routed with room, so the padframe only has to
//5: place one macro and route to on-grid boundary pins.
//no-std-cells: elaborate only -> keep the four macros, no gates/CTS/fill/taps
//placement: simple_por sits low-left; its buried vss1v8 met1 nub is connected
//placement2: post-PDN by the Reset.RescueVss1v8 step (met1 abutment + via stack).
//placement3: The other three macros sit in the upper band (y>=120). user_id's met4
//placement4: is OBS-blocked internally and its VPWR/VGND are met5 strips parallel
//placement5: to the met5 mesh, so pdn_cfg.tcl drops two short met4 stripes into its
//placement6: narrow left met4-clear strip to tap them (see the tcl).
//power: Only the four supplies the support cells use. No std-cell VPWR/VGND
//power2: sweep (macro-only block) -- it would mis-bind xres_buf's VPWR/VGND;
//power3: Odb.SetPowerConnections wires every macro power pin from the netlist.
//pdn: Macro-only block: no std-cell met1 rails. A met4/met5 mesh + core ring
//pdn2: (pdn_cfg.tcl) powers the macros via PDN_CONNECT_MACROS_TO_GRID; the ring
//pdn3: straps become the block's boundary supply pins. simple_por's buried
//pdn4: vss1v8 met1 nub is handled by a dedicated met1 GROUND stripe (see tcl).
//pdn-pitch: Pitch kept tight so a stripe set crosses every small support
//pdn-pitch3: otherwise their met4/met5 power pins get no grid (PDN-0232).
